answer: Locks are logged in tundra, expire in reef, and vertex lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 172 aliases therefore needs 87 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3139 identities would post 1287 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
